title: Hammonds, Hunter's and the Lindsays with Joe Oliver
summary: Where Freddie played at Hannan's on Murray and Custom House; Keppard played across at Hunter's with Joe Oliver, Eddie Dorsey, and the Lindsays and Fosters.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: That one place you mentioned where your brother played was at Hammonds? Hammonds. Hammonds. Hannah. Yes, sir.

Hammonds, that was on Murray, and Custom House. And when I started playing with Drew Oliver, we played in that Willie. I mean, they called Eddie Dorsey. He was our collector. He worked in the band somewhere in town, but he used to play bass, and he used to play guitar. But we taken him in to be our collector. That is at Hunters, right across from the Hammonds. We was playing right across from the Murray's brother over there after that. See, well, my brother was playing corner right there with him, with Johnny Lindsay, Herbert Lindsay, and his daddy was playing guitar. Johnny used to play bass. He played trowel now.
Yes, he played trowel. He played bass, so he's dead now, too.

Yeah, he's dead. Well, Herbert used to play violin. Never knew him. Well, Willie Foster used to play with me and Joe Oliver. He used to play violin. George Foster used to play bass, Phil, in Hunts with Joe Oliver. Because when we got the uniforms, he was playing with Joe Oliver. When I went and got Joe Oliver and Nora Dutra and all of us was together. That's why he was there with us, right across. Now, at a few close, they had old man Umpra, was playing a few close. That's on Franklin. Of course they call it something else. It's all...
